'''Prisoner Intake''' was the eastern roadway in the [[Minimum Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]] that led from [[Prison Transfer and Processing]] to the [[Primary Thoroughfare]]. Normally, it was separated from the [[Aphor Grove]] to the south and the [[Bogwing Brake]] to the north by a wall and fence respectively, but during the [[Invasion of Belsavis|riot]] during the [[Galactic War]], both barriers were breached.
